secrets.name: WB_RUNTIME_KEY_OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: the task runtime's own key for the models whose credential is OPENROUTER_API_KEY (the models of evals/eval-gate.json that pass that variable); when it is stored, every run the runtime routes to such a model uses it, and otherwise such a run uses the lab's key for the model
secrets.permission: optional: a key used only by the task runtime, with a spend cap set at the provider, for a person who wants the runtime's runs on a key of their own

secrets.name: WB_RUNTIME_KEY_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: the task runtime's own token for the models whose credential is CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; when it is stored, every run the runtime routes to such a model uses it, and otherwise such a run uses the lab's token for the model
secrets.permission: optional: a token used only by the task runtime, for a person who wants the runtime's runs on an account of their own
